title: Conditional Assignment
pyspark:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customer_new = (
    customer
    .withColumn(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("age") > 18, "Adult").otherwise("Minor")
    )
)
customer_new.createOrReplaceTempView("customer_new")

title: PROC SORT with Deduplication
pyspark:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

sales_unique = (
    sales
    .sort(F.col("region").asc(), F.col("amount").desc())
    .dropDuplicates(["region"])
)
sales_unique.createOrReplaceTempView("sales_unique")

title: PROC TRANSPOSE Pivot
pyspark:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

pivoted = (
    monthly_sales
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .pivot("month")
    .agg(F.first("revenue"))
)
pivoted.createOrReplaceTempView("pivoted")
